title: Food Preservation Tips App: CRUD tips + science methods library

requirements.text: Implement backend data model and API to allow each authenticated user (by Principal) to create, read, update, and delete their own food preservation tips/secrets, including fields: id, title, content, optional tags, createdAt, updatedAt.

quotes: Allow users to create, edit, and save their own food preservation tips/secrets.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes update/query methods to create, list, get-by-id, update, and delete tips scoped to the caller Principal.
Tip IDs are stable and unique per tip.
createdAt and updatedAt are set server-side.
A user cannot read or modify another user’s tips (Principal scoping enforced).

requirements.text: Implement backend API to provide a read-only library of simple science explanations and methods for preserving food and improving food resources. Include fields: id, title, summary, steps (optional), safetyNotes (optional), and category.

quotes: Provide a section/library of simple science explanations and methods for preserving food and improving food resources.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to list science methods and fetch a single method by id.
Science methods are read-only from the UI (no create/update/delete exposed to normal users).
At least 8 science methods are available in the library (seeded in code).

requirements.text: Create a clean, easy-to-use frontend UI that lets users browse their saved tips and browse the science methods library, with separate navigation entries for “My Tips” and “Science Library”.

quotes: Enable browsing/viewing of saved tips and science methods in a clean, easy-to-use interface.

acceptanceCriteria: User can navigate between My Tips and Science Library screens.
My Tips screen shows a list of the user’s tips and supports opening a tip detail view.
Science Library screen shows a list of science methods and supports opening a method detail view.
Loading, empty, and error states are shown for each data view.

requirements.text: Add frontend flows to create and edit a tip, including a form with title, content, and tags, plus actions to save changes and delete a tip.

quotes: Allow users to create, edit, and save their own food preservation tips/secrets.

acceptanceCriteria: User can create a new tip from My Tips and see it appear in the list after saving.
User can edit an existing tip and see updates reflected after saving.
User can delete a tip and see it removed from the list.
Form validation prevents saving when required fields (title, content) are empty.

requirements.text: Use React Query for all backend data fetching/mutations and ensure caches are invalidated/refreshed appropriately after create/update/delete operations for tips.

quotes: Enable browsing/viewing of saved tips and science methods in a clean, easy-to-use interface.

acceptanceCriteria: Lists refresh after tip create/update/delete without requiring a full page reload.
Science library queries are cached and re-used between navigations.
Errors from backend calls are surfaced to the user in a readable way.

requirements.text: Define and apply a consistent visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) with a distinct “warm kitchen notebook” aesthetic using earthy tones (avoid blue/purple) across all screens.

quotes: I’ll build a clean, easy app where users can add their preservation tips and view basic science methods that help keep food safe and lasting longer.

acceptanceCriteria: All primary screens share consistent typography, color palette, and spacing scale.
Buttons, inputs, cards, and headings follow a coherent style.
No default-looking unstyled pages remain.

requirements.text: Add a frontend static-assets integration for generated images by rendering them from frontend/public/assets/generated (e.g., logo/hero/section icons) and using them in the header and/or empty states without routing images through the backend.

quotes: I’ll build a clean, easy app where users can add their preservation tips and view basic science methods that help keep food safe and lasting longer.

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
At least a logo and one section illustration/icon are displayed in the UI.
No backend endpoints are created for serving images.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in system context; compose them instead.
Do not introduce external databases or third-party auth providers; only Internet Identity is allowed if authentication is needed.
nonGoals: Real-time collaboration or live updates (no websockets).

required: Warm kitchen notebook-style app logo: a simple line-art jar and leaf with hand-drawn feel on a cream background (app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide hero banner illustration of a pantry shelf with jars, labels, and subtle texture in earthy tones (hero-pantry.dim_1600x600.png)
Minimal icon set (3 icons) in consistent line style: jar, snowflake, salt (icons-set.dim_384x128.png)
